title: WP-P4…WP-P6 of the Portal build pack: 27 screen sheets and the i18n catalogue with the namespace allowlist (OD-P46 closed), the first frontend app apps/portal/web (Angular 22 / @detran/ui, 38 routes, guards, forms and gates, encrypted offline documents, SSE and push, 27 real screens, axe by state on every route), and the WP-P6 integration: 11 citizen journeys e2e on the API against the in-process SENATRAN mock, CNH-e/vehicle/clearance normalisation, SNE enrollment through SnePort, push idempotency, payload lint, CI backend-kernel with the mock; closure documentation

batches.headline: Delivered OD-P46 (i18n namespace allowlist in parameter-catalogue.md read by tools/parameters/verify.mjs), the app scaffold apps/portal/web (package scripts, vitest + Angular JIT transform, eslint flat, pnpm check extension, @detran/ui exports), route manifest (38 routes), guards, shell, ErrorBoundary, OfflineDocumentStore and PortalClient reads with tests (PR #60).
Delivered the 27 screen sheets IU-PORTAL-T01…T27, the i18n catalogue portal.pt-BR.json (14 allowlisted namespaces) and the screen ↔ sheet ↔ route ↔ i18n tests (PR #61).

Delivered pair 1 of the functional app: shared components §5.2, 14 schemas + FormGate (M12), PortalClient commands with If-Match and deterministic Idempotency-Key (M17), OfflineDocumentStore AES-GCM (M14), ErrorBoundary catalogue mapping, form state guards; axe by state on all 11 shared components (PR #62).

Delivered pair 2 (appeal trail): 7 PortalClient reads, five facades, PaymentComparison (80·60·40, H.53), ProcessTimeline, 13 real screens T-01…T-08/T-10/T-11/T-13/T-14/T-23; suite 972 passed | 7 todo (PR #63).

Delivered pair 3 (greenfield + PWA, closes WP-P5): 23 PortalClient reads/commands, RealtimeService (SSE + polling), PushService, InicioFacade + eight facades, functionalRouteFor, seven shared components, 22 real screens; errors/offline classified only by ErrorBoundary (A12); suite 118 files / 1314 passed | 14 todo; axe on all 38 routes (PR #64).

Delivered WP-P6 under Codex execution (Owner Amendment 2): contract CTG-0004 (74 criteria), 11 citizen journeys e2e on the API with the in-process SENATRAN mock (M18), CNH-e/vehicle/clearance normalisation (OD-P35/P36/P91 closed; vehicleId = UUIDv5 of the chassis), SNE enrollment through a mandatory SnePort (adapter → db → outbox), push-subscriptions on the M9 idempotency pattern, payload lint against internal vocabulary, CI backend-kernel with the mock before backend:test:e2e; app e2e 240 passed | 2 todo (PR #65).

Closure documentation: build pack WP-P4…P6 executed and OD-P47…P108 transcribed (64 rows), portal-frontends §9/§10, parameter catalogue OD-P66 (proposta) with regenerated artefacts, orchestra method §4.17/§4.18/§10 (R-0014 history incl. Codex execution), engineer-frontend app pattern (R-0012 copies), backlog, screen sheets T10…T18, CTG-0003c A12(j) (PR #66).
